svg.title: F for Fabrication Design and Drawings
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. An F becomes a fabricated dimensional frame with bolts, guides, and a welding spark. It develops into fabrication design and drawings, with illustrative drawing, cut plan, and frame examples. The F is newly adapted from the series palette, not the filmmaking camera poster.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; inspired by the palette of 06_F_filmmaking.png; diagrams are conceptual; no external assets.

g.text: FROM PRECISE PLANS TO REAL-WORLD BUILDS.
